meta.name: linkedin-engager-analytics
meta.description: Pull the people who liked or commented on any LinkedIn post and segment them by ICP fit (peer / aspirational / prospect / other). Produces an engager roster, tier breakdown, and outbound action lists (follow back, comment-drop, DM-able with one-line openers). Powered by Apify, no LinkedIn login. Triggers on "who liked my post", "who engaged", "engagers report", "audience analytics". Not for tracking author replies to your comments (use linkedin-thread-monitor).

copy.tagline: 分析 LinkedIn 帖子的互动者并按 ICP 分类
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 LinkedIn 上发帖并想了解谁在互动、如何跟进。
